_what: What is checked before a recording starts, and what is held while it runs (capture-preflight.mjs). Each check names a `probe` (a fact about this device that the page can read, answered by the caller), and fails when the fact is on the wrong side of a limit. `block` stops the recording before anything is asked of the person, with the plain words of `problem` (a key of capture-sources.json problems); a check without `block` only warns, and the recording still starts. A probe the device cannot answer (null) never fails a check. `hold` rows name things kept for the length of the recording, each answered by a holder the caller supplies: the device stays awake while recording. Adding a check is one row.
